title: Risk Is Not Review Value: Wrong-Answer Exposure Under Bounded Review Budgets
abstract: arXiv:2609.07095v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM assistants often produce more answers than humans can review before users see them. Most evaluations ask whether an answer is wrong, unsupported, or low-confidence. Bounded review budgets instead ask which answers should be checked first under a fixed review budget. Risk alone is not enough: a high-risk answer may be hard to repair, while a moderately risky answer may be directly correctable from available evidence. For generated-answer evaluation, we model review prioritization as exposure reduction, where review value combines estimated wrongness, intervention affordance, impact, and cost. We evaluate review queues with Wrong-Answer Exposure Ratio (WAER), the fraction of wrong answers left unreviewed, and post-repair residual exposure (PRRE), the fraction still exposed after deterministic benchmark-supported repairs. PRRE uses repairability rules that do not numerically reuse the affordance scores used for ranking. On a 720-item TA

translated_title: 风险并非审查价值：有限审查预算下的错误答案暴露
translated_abstract: LLM助手在用户看到之前，往往会产生超出人类审查能力的答案数量。大多数评估关注的是某个答案是否错误、缺乏依据或置信度低，而有限审查预算关注的是在固定审查预算下应优先检查哪些答案。仅凭风险是不够的：高风险答案可能难以修复，而中等风险的答案却可能可以依据现有证据直接纠正。针对生成答案的评估，我们将审查优先级建模为“暴露减少”问题，其中审查价值综合了估计的错误程度、干预可行性、影响和成本。我们使用错误答案暴露率（WAER，即未被审查的错误答案占比）和修复后残余暴露（PRRE，即在基于基准的确定性修复后仍然暴露的占比）来评估审查队列。PRRE所使用的可修复性规则不会在数值上复用用于排序的可行性分数。在一个包含720项的TA...（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文指出风险本身不等于审查价值，提出将审查优先级建模为“暴露减少”问题，综合估计错误程度、干预可行性、影响和成本来衡量审查价值，并引入WAER和PRRE两个新指标来评估有限审查预算下审查队列的实际效果。
en_tdlr: The paper argues that risk alone is not review value, models review prioritization as exposure reduction combining estimated wrongness, intervention affordance, impact, and cost, and introduces WAER and PRRE metrics to evaluate review queues under bounded review budgets.
